div.span:
• No automatic fallback to Nebius on any route.
• A refusal never falls back. It is a safety decision, not an outage.
• Document and message text is untrusted data, never instructions.
• Prompts and patient text are never stored in the usage log.
• Embeddings are made only for documents that benefit, deduplicated by content hash and cached by hash, model and dimensions.
• Retrieval defaults to PostgreSQL full text search.
